latHint: Think a dove carrying an olive branch.
pivHint: We LOVE because God first loved us. In Galatians, the fruit of the Spirit begins with love, joy, and ______.
winText: You found it. LOVE isn't just why we love. It's the first of the Spirit's fruit, followed by joy and PEACE.
lossText: The word was PEACE. LOVE was the pivot. In Galatians 5:22, Paul lists the fruit of the Spirit in order, beginning LOVE, joy, PEACE.
votdVerse: We love because he first loved us.
passageText: We love because he first loved us. Whoever claims to love God yet hates a brother or sister is a liar. For whoever does not love their brother and sister, whom they have seen, cannot love God, whom they have not seen. And he has given us this command: Anyone who loves God must also love their brother and sister.
